summary: R. Venkatraman is an indologist and historian who earned his PhD from Madurai Kamaraj University (1975–1980) under doctoral supervisors N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan. He served as a Reader at Madurai Kamaraj University (attested 1990).

Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) was a philosopher and religious studies scholar who studied at St. Xavier's Collegiate School and University College London. He founded Visva-Bharati University and the Sino-Indian Cultural Society.
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York. Around 2014, she held a post as a lecturer at the University of Liverpool.

Rachel H. Pang is a scholar of religious studies, Tibetology, and Sinology who earned her PhD from the University of Virginia. In 2019, she was attested as Lester D. Coltrane III Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College.

Rachelle M. Scott is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who completed her dissertation at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay. She held a post at the University of Tennessee (attested 2009–2017).

Radha Krishna Choudhary (1921–1985) was an Indian historian and indologist educated at Tej Narayan Banaili College and Patna University. He headed the History Department at Ganesh Dutt College, served as principal of Shankar Sah Vikramshila Mahavidyalaya, and taught at Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University.

Radha Kumud Mukherjee (1884–1963) was an indologist and historian who studied at the University of Calcutta. He held posts at Banaras Hindu University (~1916–1917) and Maharaja's College, University of Mysore (~1917–1921), where he headed the Department of History.

Radhika Herzberger is an indologist and philosopher who earned her PhD from the University of Toronto (~1974–1982) under Bimal Krishna Matilal. She served as Director of the Rishi Valley School from circa 1982 to 2012.

Rafal Stepien is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who completed his PhD at Columbia University under Chün-fang Yü and Bernard Faure. He was an Academic Visitor at Wadham College (2012–2013) and an Exchange Scholar at Harvard University (2015).
Rafał Jan Felbur is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who studied at Stanford University, working under doctoral supervisor Paul Harrison and teachers John R. McRae and Luis O. Gómez.

Raffaele Torella is an indologist and philosopher who studied under Raniero Gnoli. He held a professorship at the University of Naples "L'Orientale" (1980–1994) and served as a faculty member at Sapienza University of Rome (~1994–2020).
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar of Sinology and Buddhist studies who earned his PhD from Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan is a philosopher and religious studies scholar who studied at IIT Madras and trained under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. He taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and was a visiting faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad (2010).

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) was an indologist and Buddhist studies scholar educated at Punjab, London, and Leiden. He headed the Sanskrit Department at Sanatan Dharma College (~1932–1946) and founded the International Academy of Indian Culture, serving as its founding director in 1934.

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) was an indologist and philosopher. He served as principal of Sir Parashurambhau College and later worked as a professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri was an indologist and philosopher who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya and held a post as department head at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Peter Das is an indologist and linguist who studied at Calcutta, Cologne, and Hamburg under Klaus Ludwig Janert and Albrecht Wezler. He taught at Hamburg, Bonn, Groningen, and Marburg before serving as Professor of South Asian Studies at Halle-Wittenberg (1994–2020).

Rahul Sankrityayan (1893–1963) was an indologist, Tibetologist, and Buddhist studies scholar. He taught Sanskrit at Vidyalankara Pirivena (1927) and later served as a Sanskrit teacher and professor at Saint Petersburg State University (1937, 1945–1947).

Raimo Anttila (1935–2023) was a linguist and indologist who studied at Yale University under Warren Cowgill (~1962–1966). He held posts at the University of California, Los Angeles (1965) and the University of Helsinki (1971–1976).

Raimon Panikkar (1918–2010) was a religious studies scholar and philosopher who studied at Madrid, Lateran, Bonn, Barcelona, Mysore, and BHU. He taught at Madrid (1946–1953), Harvard (1966–1971), and UC Santa Barbara (1971–1978; emeritus ~1987–2010).
